sql: SELECT regexp_replace(regexp_replace(strategy,'_h[0-9]+$',''),'^weather_(low_)?','') AS book, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='settled') AS n, round(sum(pnl) FILTER (WHERE status='settled')::numeric,2) AS total, round(avg(pnl) FILTER (WHERE status='settled')::numeric*100,1) AS c_per_trade, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='open') AS open_n, max(created_at)::date AS last_entry FROM paper_trades WHERE strategy LIKE 'weather%' AND NOT legacy GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total DESC NULLS LAST
